theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_smp_pairing_integrable
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ξ μ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → Integrable (fun x => ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x)) μ
